sourceChange: D3 changes only host cancellation to the existing aborted collector status, constructor-row endpoint census and diagnostic label. It reuses the genuine D2 image and unchanged authenticated native producer.

emitWindow.scope: first observed emitter boundary through last observation; not entire compiler lifetime
emitWindow.limitEnforcement: host boundaries only; cannot interrupt one native step

hostBoundaries.evidence: all observed host boundaries only; not all internal64 transitions

dispatchers.reason: step_one matches every RequestGroup; each group handler matches every request constructor and statically calls its stepBody (checker_core_step_lower.ts:2414-2423). Ordinary graph reachability follows every branch; only a proven finite incoming-tag flow can narrow it.

widening: reachable higher-order Apply/TailApply: no interprocedural closure-flow proof; all code/declarations retained
reachable foreign declaration: callbacks/returned higher-order values are opaque; retain every code/declaration
layout obligation widening retains every constructor row, every family arm and every type-function definition

retainedLongerPrefix.note: Valid authenticated data prefix retained despite rejected finalizer. No original failed command is relabeled PASS; sampled/trace time is not uninstrumented exclusive CPU.

decision.plainDCEOrLazyContext: REJECTED_AS_NEXT_COMPILER_CUTOVER: no removal certified; needed CheckerRunState still forces the large protocol layout.
decision.fullProtocolSpecialization: NOT_DISPROVED_BUT_DEFERRED: requires interprocedural constructor-tag/closure flow and private-type representation proof, not just call-graph trimming.
decision.nextArchitecture: Storage-directed semantic descriptor/query DAG at the backend-owned boundary: stop repeated instantiated NF/reentry expansion without changing ABI, scopes, fuel or failure meaning.
decision.nextFalsifier: Count distinct fully scoped NF/reentry query identities (context, descriptor, environment, output level, budget; target/seen for reach) versus total evaluations. If sharing is small, reject the DAG rationale before rewriting the IR.
decision.conditionalAlternative: Typed first-order continuation work only after an uninstrumented administrative-cost measurement; traced spans/host-boundary samples do not establish that share.
hardRules: No SHOW/LLVM-only retry for this pre-render IO path
No erased/generic/closure/dependent scope shortcut without semantic proof
No negative reach proof from fuel exhaustion/NfFail
No C-only speedup claimed as strict12 JS-library improvement
All original acceptance remains unchanged for a real future candidate

limitsOfClaims: Diagnostic observed prefix, not completed C emission or measured speedup.
Marked Begin/End counts belong to the instrumented composition.
Observer wall and inspector/trace overhead overlap phase spans; cannot subtract them to invent baseline timings.
Nested inclusive call durations are not summed or interpreted as exclusive CPU.
There is no allocation count or full internal64 transition count from host-boundary samples.
The first canonical node is CheckerRunState by constructor endpoint plus generated tail-before-node planning order, not a fixture-name special case.
